name: pxcp-ui
description: Extract PXCP design files into artboard specs, assets, previews, implementation hints, and reference screenshots for precise UI implementation.

interface.shortDescription: Extract PXCP designs into UI specs, previews, and implementation hints.
interface.longDescription: PXCP UI parses .pxcp design files, extracts embedded artboard JSON and image assets, generates CSS-ready layer summaries, browser previews, component candidates, responsive hints, and guides Codex through precise UI implementation with screenshot verification.
interface.defaultPrompt: Extract this .pxcp file and help me implement the selected artboard precisely.
